description: Data foundation: finalize prisma/schema.prisma against the full MVP domain, generate the Prisma client, push it to the already-reachable Postgres on localhost:5449, add an idempotent seed script (initial accountant + default Dutch BTW categories), wire npm scripts, and document setup in README.md. Independent of all other FEATs — everything downstream reads/writes through this schema and the seeded accountant/categories.
steps: Read prisma/schema.prisma (already contains User/Role, ClientProfile/ClientStatus, InvitationToken, Category, Expense/ExpenseStatus per setup-report.md). Confirm every field the later FEATs need is present: User.role, User.locale (default 'es'), User.password (bcryptjs hash); ClientProfile.status (INVITED/ACTIVE/SUSPENDED) and accountantId relation; InvitationToken.tokenHash (SHA-256 hex, unique), expiresAt, usedAt; Category.accountantId + @@unique([accountantId, name]) + defaultDeductible + defaultBtwRate; Expense.classificationConfidence, deductible, btwRate, status, reviewNote, reviewedById, reviewedAt, locked, currency default 'EUR'. If anything from this list is missing, add it with a minimal, additive migration-safe change (prefer `db push` over writing a migration, since no migrations/ dir exists yet).
Run `npx prisma generate` then `npx prisma db push` against DATABASE_URL (postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5449/ledger_ocr) and confirm both succeed with no data-loss prompt.

Create scripts/seed.ts: idempotent (use `upsert` keyed on unique fields, safe to re-run) seed that creates one ACCOUNTANT User (email from env SEED_ACCOUNTANT_EMAIL or a fixed placeholder like accountant@ledger-ocr.local, password hashed with bcryptjs from SEED_ACCOUNTANT_PASSWORD or a fixed dev-only default, locale 'nl'), and a handful of default Category rows scoped to that accountant with realistic Dutch BTW rates (0%, 9%, 21%) and deductible flags (e.g. 'Kantoorbenodigdheden' 21% deductible, 'Reiskosten' 0% deductible, 'Representatie' 21% not fully deductible, 'Verzekeringen' 21% deductible). Never read or write real secrets from .env into the seed beyond the DATABASE_URL connection — the accountant password is a seed-only dev credential, documented as such in README.

Add npm scripts to package.json: `db:generate` (`prisma generate`), `db:push` (`prisma db push`), `db:seed` (`tsx scripts/seed.ts` or `node --loader ts-node/esm scripts/seed.ts` — pick whichever runs cleanly with the installed toolchain; if neither tsx nor ts-node is installed, add tsx as an exact-pinned devDependency since it's the lighter dependency), and `db:reset` (optional convenience: `prisma db push --force-reset && npm run db:seed`) only if trivial.

Update README.md: replace the default create-next-app boilerplate with real setup docs — required env vars (list each from .env.example/.env with a one-line purpose, do not print real secret values), `docker compose up -d` to start Postgres on port 5449, `npm install`, `npm run db:generate`, `npm run db:push`, `npm run db:seed`, `npm run dev`, and a note that /api/health verifies DB connectivity.

Run `npm run lint`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, and `npm run build` and fix any errors introduced by the new scripts/seed.ts (ensure it's excluded from the Next.js build if it causes issues, e.g. by relying on tsconfig's existing `**/*.ts` include which already covers scripts/).
acceptance_criteria: `npx prisma generate` and `npx prisma db push` both complete with no errors against localhost:5449
`npm run db:seed` run twice in a row completes both times without throwing (idempotent) and results in exactly one accountant user and the same set of categories (no duplicates)
README.md documents every env var in .env and the exact seed/setup commands
`npm run lint`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, and `npm run build` all pass
verification: `npx prisma generate` — expect '✔ Generated Prisma Client' with no errors
`npx prisma db push` — expect 'Your database is now in sync with your Prisma schema' with no errors

`npm run db:seed` (run twice) — expect a success log both times, confirm via a quick `npx prisma studio`-free check: a one-off script or `npx prisma db execute` SELECT count, or simplest: log counts inside seed.ts itself after upsert and verify constant across both runs
`npm run build` — succeeds, prints the route list including /api/health
findings: schema.prisma already contained every field FEATs 002-005 need (no schema changes were made): User.role/locale(default 'es')/password, ClientProfile.status/accountantId, InvitationToken.tokenHash(unique)/expiresAt/usedAt, Category.accountantId+@@unique([accountantId,name])+defaultDeductible+defaultBtwRate, Expense.classificationConfidence/deductible/btwRate/status/reviewNote/reviewedById/reviewedAt/locked/currency(default 'EUR'). `npx prisma generate` and `npx prisma db push` both ran clean against postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5449/ledger_ocr. Added scripts/seed.ts (idempotent upsert-based). Seeded accountant: email 'accountant@ledger-ocr.local' (overridable via SEED_ACCOUNTANT_EMAIL env var), password is a dev-only bcryptjs hash from SEED_ACCOUNTANT_PASSWORD or default 'dev-only-password-123' (never a real secret), role ACCOUNTANT, locale 'nl'. Seeded 4 default Category rows scoped to that accountant: 'Kantoorbenodigdheden' (21% BTW, deductible), 'Reiskosten' (0% BTW, deductible), 'Representatie' (21% BTW, NOT deductible), 'Verzekeringen' (21% BTW, deductible) — FEAT-002's category CRUD and FEAT-00x's classification logic should expect these exact names/rates to already exist for the seeded accountant. npm scripts added: db:generate (prisma generate), db:push (prisma db push), db:seed (tsx scripts/seed.ts), db:reset (prisma db push --force-reset && npm run db:seed). tsx 4.20.5 pinned exactly as a new devDependency (neither tsx nor ts-node was previously installed). README.md rewritten with an env var table and full setup steps. User-verified manually (agent's own bash tool hit the known 130/^C runner block): npm install OK (npm audit reports 10 vulnerabilities, 8 high/2 critical, in transitive Next/Prisma ecosystem deps — not addressed in this FEAT, flagging for awareness, not blocking MVP), prisma generate OK, db:seed run twice produced identical accountantUserCount=1/categoryCount=4 both times (idempotency confirmed), lint clean, tsc --noEmit clean, build succeeded with /api/health route listed.
